extra.donor_retention_note: model donor decodability divided by raw-expression donor decodability under the identical readout budget. >1 means the representation surfaces more donor identity than raw expression does at the same capacity.

Internals leak more donor identity than the sanctioned surface does, so the sanctioned surface is hiding nuisance structure rather than removing it.
